question_summary: Cast-in anchor bolt group location at Gridline B/2 in Foundation Plan S-101 conflicts with mechanical ductwork and architectural ceiling framing routing shown in Structural Detail 3/S502, holding up steel fabrication release.
proposed_solution: Revise the cast-in anchor bolt group per Structural Detail 3/S502; coordinate final dimensions with the affected trades before fabrication.
deadline_text: We need this resolved before the next steel erection mobilization.
routing_rationale: The conflict centers on structural anchor bolt placement conflicting with other trades, requiring the structural engineer to resolve the discrepancy and coordinate with mechanical and architectural teams.
